ESTORE-001.md:71.
Evidence: D-pre requires both installs, the completed Windows trace matrix, an AGREE plan receipt and the operator release before D0. The handoff v2 section 11 records explicit plan-review authority and the continuing implementation hold.
Assessment: A plan review is authorized before execution. D3 defers implementation HV to step 12; this review supplies no execution release.
Required action / acceptance outcome: Retain the explicit release gate and deferred implementation review.

P05 PASS [info]: Both desktop installs. Source: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:71.
Evidence: Linux 20261020T105400-phase-d-pre-desktop-install-linux and Windows 20261020T121000-phase-d-pre-desktop-install-windows receipts record Nuke installation of 1.3.111 from 2c8d6028, including installed ProductVersion and hashes.
Assessment: The stated desktop precondition is supported by receipts. No new installed-binary or GUI check was run in this review.
Required action / acceptance outcome: Bind those receipts to D0 and retain their host attribution.

P06 PASS [info]: Phase C evidence scope. Source: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:14.
Evidence: Linux S2b, S3 and S4c receipts and the Windows 20261020T102600 equivalence receipt support clean materialization builds and seeded reset-workload observation/equivalence at 100k and 1M on both machines and 4M on x64sc. They explicitly defer real snapshot cross-checks to Phase D.
Assessment: Phase C proves the bounded bus observer and equivalence claims, not native snapshot resume, a replacement DLL ABI or managed parity.
Required action / acceptance outcome: Keep the workload, seed, A1/A2 applicability and trace provenance attached to each later claim.

P07 PASS [info]: Preserve, restore and retirement authority. Source: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:72.
Evidence: D0 copies and hash-verifies modified and injected source while retaining originals; D4 restores only explicit tracked paths after preservation; R2/R3 explicitly authorize retirement of the named shim builders. A03 forbids automatic patch reapply and untracked deletion.
Assessment: Copy/hash/retain and the narrow authorized restore are compatible with the standing no-move rule. No restoration is authorized during this review.
Required action / acceptance outcome: Execute only after all D4 prerequisites and the operator release are met.

F01 PASS [medium]: Corrected counts. Source: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:8.
Evidence: Independent status enumeration is 163 entries: 8 modified and 155 untracked. The complete Oct 4 inventory has 2527 paths, including 745 .o, 59 .a, 2 .exe, 1432 .Po and 107 .in files. See historical-inventory.json.
Assessment: The earlier 135-path count and extension spelling defects are corrected.
Required action / acceptance outcome: Use the fresh host-specific D0 inventory rather than extrapolating these counts to Windows.

F02 PASS [high]: Executable native builder caller. Source: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:74.
Evidence: ViceSharp.TestHarness.csproj line 10 sets ViceNativeProject and line 72 invokes BuildNative on Windows. The scoped source/build search finds that project caller. D2 explicitly removes both lines and requires no BuildNative or shim-script call in both build logs before retiring Vice.Native.proj.
Assessment: The omitted build-time caller has a concrete disposition and a verification owner.
Required action / acceptance outcome: Retain the no-reference receipt before deletion and both-host build-log checks.

F03 FAIL [high]: Semantic inventory fixed, zero-load proof still assumes nonexistent logging. Source: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:49.
Evidence: The raw semantic-token search finds 56 candidate .cs files, versus 43 in the old token set; plain Fact users exist. R6 now correctly owns per-method direct/transitive enumeration and excludes strings. But it says both resolvers log their resolved path. ViceNative.cs lines 36-71 only resolves and loads; lines 81-84 return an AvailabilityMessage string. ViceNative.Xvic.cs lines 31-40 uses that same combined resolver and also only returns a message. Neither path emits a load log.
Assessment: The inventory amendment is substantive, but an empty purported resolver log cannot establish zero native loads. D2 does not own adding this missing observation or another valid load detector. The 56 figure remains candidates, not all methods to tag.
Required action / acceptance outcome: Keep the semantic inventory and exp
